_about: Default consent banner wording (English, plain). A project replaces any field in brief.json compliance.consent_text; the copywriter (S5) writes it in the site's language. Reject and accept must stay equally plain.
title: Cookie choices
body: We would like to use the tools below. Nothing beyond what the site needs to work runs until you choose, and you can change your mind at any time from the link at the foot of every page.
gpc: Your browser sent a Global Privacy Control signal, so advertising and data sharing stay off.

analytics.label: Measurement
analytics.desc: Counts visits so we can see which pages help.

marketing.label: Advertising and sharing
marketing.desc: Lets advertising partners show and measure ads. In some places this counts as selling or sharing data.

media.label: Embedded media
media.desc: Loads videos and maps from other sites, which can set their own cookies.
